summary: Correct the 2*top_k outgoing-panel bound: build_panels() tests picked_n only at the top of its while loop while the inner for adds one partner per via, so panels overshoot (measured max 22 at top_k=5, 1,804 panels over 10) — decide doc-fix vs enforce
